intro: A bowl of mee udang has an estimated 520 kcal. Most of the calories come from the yellow noodles and the thick prawn kuah.

breakdown.part: Half boiled egg, taugeh & fried shallots

variants.name: Mee udang with big udang galah

diet: Yes, you can enjoy it, especially when you're out at Kuala Sepetang or a seafood place. Prawns give you good protein that's low in fat. What pushes the calories up is the thick kuah and a big portion of noodles. Make it your one heavier meal of the day and keep your other meals light.
tips: Ask for less mee and more prawns or vegetables.
Eat the prawns and toppings first, just sip a bit of the kuah.
Skip the fried version, go for the soup one.

swap.name: Grilled/steamed prawns + half cup rice + vegetables
swap.why: Same high protein, fewer carbs and no thick kuah.

faq.q: Where is mee udang most famous?
faq.a: Kuala Sepetang in Perak and Teluk Intan are popular spots. Many shops use fresh udang galah.

faq.q: Prawns are high in cholesterol, can I eat them?
faq.a: Prawns do have cholesterol, but they're low in saturated fat. For most healthy people, eating them once in a while is okay. If you have a health condition, check with your doctor.

faq.q: What is mee udang kuah made of?
faq.a: Usually prawn heads and shells boiled with spices, sometimes with flour added to thicken it.
